target.statement: Approximation method converges to 100% accuracy within 500 epochs on 1,000,000 samples with 100 dimensions (while Perceptron fails within 1000 epochs)
target.dataset: synthetic linearly separable data (1M samples, 100 features, generated as described in Section 5)

compute.basis: Synthetic data is generated by a simple described procedure; the algorithm is a few lines of numpy; 1M x 100 float64 matrix is ~800 MB and a few hundred epochs of vectorized dot products run in minutes on CPU.

blockers: no code released; algorithm and data generator must be reimplemented from the paper text
exact epoch counts/curves depend on random seeds and epsilon, so exact figure reproduction is approximate
title: A Perceptron-based Fine Approximation Technique for Linear Separation
